summary.text: Michael J. Marcotte, a Republican from Coventry, has represented Orleans-Lamoille in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2005.
He chairs the House Committee on Commerce and Economic Development.

paragraphs.text: Marcotte was born in Newport, Vermont, has lived in Coventry since 1978, and is a businessman and store owner, according to his House biography.
He was educated at Sacred Heart Graded and High Schools in Newport.
He has served as chairman of the Coventry Selectboard and joined the Economic Development Council of Northern Vermont Board of Directors in 2006.
He was elected to the board of the Orleans/Essex VNA & Hospice in 2007 and became its president in 2010.
He is married to Danielle, and they have two sons and one granddaughter.
